answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can grow like an orchard: every newcomer must be vouched for by an existing agent that locks real collateral behind the vouch. If the newcomer is later proven fake, the voucher stake is slashed too, and the loss climbs up the chain. Each marble of trust carries a price tag, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand times the collateral. The old fable of the free lunch dies: minting identities is cheap only when nobody pays, but with cascading slashing the attacker pays for every single one.
